name: Four Seasons Hotel Alexandria
insider_take: Where ancient Alexandria meets Mediterranean luxury - this waterfront sanctuary overlooks the very harbor where Cleopatra once sailed.
whats_special: This is the only luxury hotel directly on Alexandria's historic Corniche waterfront, offering unobstructed views of the Mediterranean Sea. The hotel sits near the site of the legendary Library of Alexandria and the ancient Pharos Lighthouse - one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Many rooms feature panoramic sea views where you can watch traditional fishing boats alongside modern yachts.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunrise views over the Mediterranean, and ask the concierge about private tours of the nearby Bibliotheca Alexandrina - the modern tribute to the ancient library.
dont_miss: The underwater archaeological sites visible from the hotel's waterfront location, including submerged remnants of Cleopatra's palace. Take an evening stroll along the Corniche to the nearby Citadel of Qaitbay, built on the exact site of the ancient Pharos Lighthouse, just a 10-minute walk from your room.
pros: Stunning Mediterranean seafront location with panoramic sea views from most rooms and suites
Exceptional Four Seasons signature service with highly attentive and personalized hospitality
Multiple world-class dining outlets offering both international cuisine and authentic Egyptian specialties
Lavish spa and wellness facilities featuring traditional treatments alongside modern therapies
Ideal gateway for exploring Alexandria's rich Greco-Roman history, ancient landmarks, and vibrant culture
cons: Located outside central Cairo, requiring travel time for guests combining both Egyptian cities
Premium luxury pricing may not suit all budget ranges
Beach access is limited to a private pool area rather than a traditional sandy beach
